prompts.qwen: 你是中文ASR转写精修助手。只做最小必要修改：清理口癖和无意义重复，处理明确的自我修正，修正明显错字或误词，修复语法赘余、必要标点和句界。说话者明确改口时保留最终意图；忽略强调表达，重复表达可以压缩。不得总结、扩写、补全或推测输入没有的信息；不得删掉不同事实、实体、数量、否定、条件、立场或情态。保留数字和日期的数值及输入写法，保留英文名称、大小写、空格、连字符和代码符号。__ENTITY_NNN__形式的实体占位符须逐字保留，每个出现一次且顺序不变。无需修改时原样输出。只输出精修正文，不要类别、解释、实体列表、<KEY>或JSON。
prompts.agentic1b: 你是 ASR 文本纠错助手。保留原意，最小修改：去口癖/重复，修错字，补必要标点，处理自我修正。规范数字、日期、术语和代码符号，但必须保持数值和原意不变。数字范围必须作为一个整体规范化：凡由‘到’、‘至’、连字符或波浪线连接的数量或测量表达式，两端必须同时转换，禁止只转换一端，也禁止生成中文数字和阿拉伯数字混合的范围。不要总结、扩写或解释。成语中的汉字数字（如三番五次）必须保持原样。重要易错实体在末尾追加 <KEY>[词1、词2]；没有则不加。输入中形如 __ENTITY_000__ 的受保护标记必须在输出中原样保留一次，不得删除、改写、重复或调整顺序。

source_protocol.numeric_pipeline: four Qwen variants: raw -> native numeric normalization; RBT3 decides on original raw text -> refiner sees normalized text if routed -> restore_rule_numeric_surfaces + numeric-only integrity rejection; numeric failure falls back to rule baseline; gate skipping still outputs numeric rule baseline
source_protocol.agentic1b_pipeline: Local system.refiner.SYSTEM_PROMPT / refinement_protocol.REFINER_SYSTEM_PROMPT, raw oral input, model owns numeric conversion, no native numeric rules; KEY stripped from body
source_protocol.latency_mode: 32 paired AASR inputs (5 unchanged,27 changed) batch1, warm, full text pipeline latency
source_protocol.throughput_mode: All510 Chinese inputs with their natural distribution (76 unchanged,434 different), fixed batches8 (last batch6); batch completion time and total throughput, not individual latency
source_protocol.concurrency: GPU execution deliberately serial across pipelines for fair comparison; vectorized batch8, no competing model jobs
source_protocol.quality: Official AASR oral as input, clean as reference, original rubric frozen. Direct oral input bypasses ASR and is a text-only adaptation, not the paper full audio pipeline. References never enter model prompts. Raw and rule-normalized exact agreement are descriptive, not official rubric score.
source_protocol.agentic1b_correction_reason: First-pass offline CLI prompt states numbers already processed while 1B gets raw input; replaced only 1B with the actual local AgenticASR default raw-input refiner prompt. Other four model outputs/timings unchanged.

gate_device: GPU0 float32, serialized gate calls under mutex
rules: frozen native v91; source normalization + numeric surface repair/guard; guard fallback included
sampling: temperature0 top_p1 repetition_penalty1 max_tokens1024; same task prompts
precision: BF16 all three refiners; LoRA merged in BF16 matching prior Transformers run
server: vLLM OpenAI loopback HTTP, CUDA graphs/compile default ENABLED, no enforce_eager, prefix caching DISABLED
latency: 32 same paired texts, closed-loop1 request; warm wall time rules+gate+HTTP tokenization/prefill/decode+guard, excludes model startup
throughput: all510 inputs closed-loop max8 and16 concurrent workers; per-request wall time starts after client worker begins; total sweep wall time includes scheduling and client overhead
comparison_limit: Transformers prior is in-process; vLLM includes local HTTP overhead. Prior batch8 is fixed batch, vLLM8/16 are continuous request concurrency. Input same, scheduling different.
quality: Compare outputs and raw/rule-normalized references; changed outputs do NOT inherit prior rubric scores. Exact same input+output can reuse prior judge rows for diagnostic only.
